title: Dubstep
tagline: Sub-bass pressure, half-time rhythms, and space between the beats.
summary: Dubstep emerged in South London from UK garage, dub, and soundsystem culture. Early tracks used sparse half-time rhythms, deep sub-bass, and a strong sense of space. The style later branched into many forms, from atmospheric productions to more aggressive festival sounds, while its low-frequency focus remains a defining feature.

pillars.name: Skream
pillars.why: Skream was among the early producers whose releases helped define dubstep's first wave.

pillars.name: Benga
pillars.why: Benga helped shape the Croydon scene with bass-heavy productions and influential collaborations.

pillars.name: Digital Mystikz
pillars.why: Digital Mystikz connected dubstep to deep bass, dubplate culture, and the community around DMZ nights.
